nodes.label: Analytics metrics and honesty requirements
nodes.rationale: Metrics from actual user records, explain small samples, no fabricated benchmarks, distinguish correlation from causation.

nodes.label: Application status lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Discovered, Shortlisted, Referral Requested, Referred, Applied, Interview, then Offer/Rejected/Withdrawn; status history preserved; duplicate active applications prevented.

nodes.label: Evidence over guesses
nodes.rationale: Every job and referral lead must have a traceable source; never invent vacancy, contact, relationship, salary or date.

nodes.label: Human approval for external actions
nodes.rationale: Never submit an application or send a referral message automatically.

nodes.label: Outreach strategies and drafting rules
nodes.rationale: No fabricated familiarity, no auto-sending, limited follow-ups, drafts use only known context.

nodes.label: Phase 4 - Referral intelligence
nodes.rationale: Relationships are derived from recorded facts, never typed in; every lead needs a source URL.

nodes.label: Referral lead evidence and confidence labels
nodes.norm_label: referral lead evidence and confidence labels
nodes.rationale: Distinguish verified, inferred and unknown relationships; never claim unsupported mutual connections; do not scrape behind login.

nodes.label: Phase 5: outreach strategist
nodes.rationale: Copy-only; nothing is ever sent; strategies limited to those the facts support.

nodes.label: buildAiContext allowlist (domain/ai/context.ts)
nodes.rationale: Each field copied by name; a field added later is not exported until someone adds it here.

nodes.label: planApply (re-reads live record on accept)
nodes.rationale: A recommendation made last week cannot overwrite a decision made since.

nodes.label: Auto-apply notes and follow-ups (confidence >= 0.6)
nodes.rationale: Only low-risk, reversible changes apply automatically; everything else waits for one click ('Accept all ready').

nodes.label: AI result schema v2
nodes.rationale: Superset of v1 (v1 still accepted); adds kinds resume-suggestion, lead-proposal, prep-plan, application-update and actions add-lead, set-stage (forward only).

nodes.label: auto-sources.yml board discovery merge
nodes.rationale: Merges only additions to collector/sources.json that verify-sources confirms list engineering roles in Bengaluru/Hyderabad.

nodes.label: Phase 2: job discovery
nodes.rationale: Only stable public ATS APIs (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby); scope Bengaluru and Hyderabad only.

nodes.label: Phase 7: scheduled automation and reminders
nodes.rationale: Cron kept in UTC rather than timezone key so an unsupported key can never silently stop scans.

nodes.label: Private repo sync (context/latest.json, profile/resume.md)
nodes.rationale: Client checks repo is private before every sync; token sent only to api.github.com and stripped from backups.

nodes.label: Subscription cost implications
nodes.rationale: A1 adds no cost; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in shell would bill API usage, so export screen warns.

nodes.label: A2: Local scheduled runs
nodes.rationale: Gated on Anthropic terms for unattended subscription use; folded into A3.

nodes.label: Daily Claude routine (08:30 IST)
nodes.rationale: Runs on owner's subscription in the cloud even with the laptop closed; instructions live in private repo docs/daily-routine.md.

nodes.label: Manual hand-off to Claude
nodes.rationale: A static website cannot start a Claude session on its own; no backend, API key or paid service, so the hand-off is a deliberate visible user step.

nodes.label: Decisions taken 2026-11-03
nodes.rationale: Automate with minimal interaction; unattended Pro runs ok at one per day; private repo holds context; resume stored; referral people only with public source.

nodes.label: createHashRouter
nodes.rationale: Pages cannot rewrite unknown paths to index.html; hash routes survive a refresh.

nodes.label: scan.yml calls pages.yml (workflow_call)
nodes.rationale: A push made with GITHUB_TOKEN doesn't trigger workflows, so scan.yml calls pages.yml with ref: main.

nodes.label: Static React SPA on GitHub Pages (no backend)
nodes.norm_label: static react spa on github pages (no backend)
nodes.rationale: Pages serves static files only; free plan requires a public repo containing code only.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions schedule trade-offs
nodes.rationale: Schedules can be delayed, run from default branch, disabled after 60 days inactivity in public repos; avoid top-of-hour; use Asia/Kolkata timezone; private-repo minutes may cost.

nodes.label: Definition of success
nodes.rationale: Honest about trade-off: Pages hosts UI and static data but cannot provide a private server, live backend or cross-device sync.

nodes.label: GitHub Pages architecture constraints
nodes.rationale: Pages is static hosting only; no server-side code, so the app is a compiled Vite/React SPA.

nodes.label: Explicit non-goals (no backend, no LinkedIn scraper, no auto-send)
nodes.norm_label: explicit non-goals (no backend, no linkedin scraper, no auto-send)
nodes.rationale: Cross-device sync, private storage or real-time notifications would be a separate architecture decision requiring an approved backend.

nodes.label: Scheduled and manual scan automation
nodes.rationale: Static site cannot wake itself or hold a PAT; client-side trigger of Actions would need an external authenticated mechanism.

nodes.label: Recommended stack
nodes.rationale: Avoid heavy UI kits for precise design control; HashRouter avoids server-side route rewrites on project Pages URLs; IndexedDB handles structured larger records.

nodes.label: AI context export is an allowlist
nodes.norm_label: ai context export is an allowlist
nodes.rationale: Add fields deliberately, default sensitive ones off, extend context.test.ts sentinel checks; app never calls an AI service and holds no key.

nodes.label: jobintel-ai-result schema v1 contract
nodes.rationale: JSON Schema for the model is generated from the same Zod schema so the contract has one source of truth; future versions added alongside, not by loosening.

nodes.label: Grounding rule (external-only evidence capped at 0.5 confidence)
nodes.norm_label: grounding rule (external-only evidence capped at 0.5 confidence)

nodes.label: Per-item partial import

nodes.label: Zod validation on every read, write and import
nodes.norm_label: zod validation on every read, write and import
nodes.rationale: Persisted or imported data is never trusted.

nodes.label: Development workflow and guardrails
nodes.rationale: Feature branch, small commits, no mock data, typed repositories, stop and document trade-offs rather than quietly adding a backend.

nodes.label: Phase 1 explicit non-goals
nodes.rationale: No fictional seed data; empty states are correct behavior.

nodes.label: Product vision (optimize for relevant interviews)
nodes.rationale: Optimize for relevant interviews secured, not the number of job listings collected.

nodes.label: Initial discovery configuration target
nodes.rationale: Start with a few scans per day rather than aggressive polling; up to 100 companies added incrementally. Original brief targets Bengaluru/India/Remote India (repo rules later narrow to Bengaluru + Hyderabad).

nodes.label: Public jobs.json feed (public/data/jobs.json)
nodes.rationale: Contains only public vacancy facts and source metadata, never candidate data; failed scan leaves last known good feed.

nodes.label: Deterministic match score weights
nodes.rationale: Skills 30%, experience 20%, responsibility 20%, location 10%, seniority 10%, other 10%; computed in browser so profile stays local; missing fields never silently count as a match.

nodes.norm_label: graph refresh policy (ci code update, manual doc update)
nodes.rationale: CI (graph.yml) runs graphify update on push to main for code; docs cannot be re-extracted semantically in CI so /graphify . --update must be run and committed in the same PR. Never rebuild from scratch unless graph.json is missing.

nodes.label: Use the knowledge graph first
nodes.rationale: Reading graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md and querying the graph orients an agent without reading the whole repo; fall back to grep/Read only when the graph has no match.
